title: Chapter 815
text:
Shattered Star Ring, Blue Star.

The blue planet rotated slowly. Occasionally, streams of light would fly out from the planet, and there would also be streams of light coming from the universe. Batches of spaceships were arriving and departing.

The sun shone on the capital city filled with skyscrapers, and the windows reflected the blue sky and white clouds. Trains whizzed past along the tracks in the sky, and anti-gravity vehicles shuttled between the cities. The entire city was filled with life, and it was a peaceful and prosperous scene.

At the dock of the capital Black Star City, Bennett was waiting with a bunch of people.

Standing in front of the window and looking down at the lively capital, Bennett had a gratified expression on his face.

After Han Xiao helped Blue Star join the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Conference, many financial groups and organizations placed more importance on the development of Blue Star, which brought a new round of development opportunities for Blue Star. Trade became more frequent, and it became more and more prosperous.

The people of Blue Star, who had experienced many hardships, were smiling more and more. The more they enjoyed the prosperity of their mother planet, the more they admired Black Star, who had brought them all of this.

A spaceship entered the dock, and the hatch opened. A few army soldiers escorted Nero out of the spaceship. When Nero saw Bennett, he had an expression of reuniting with his family and quickly ran to Bennett.

"Dad!"

Bennett turned around and looked at him with confusion. "Why are you back so quickly? What did Black Star bring you to do in the universe?"

Nero scratched his head and said with a depressed tone, "I spent most of my time learning Mechanic theory. Godfather brought me out for a vacation for a few days and then threw me back down …"

Han Xiao had brought a large number of troops to develop the Flickering World and did not know when he would be back. Naturally, he did not bring Nero along and instructed Sylvia to send him back to Blue Star.

As he spoke, Nero was a little depressed.

"Mr. Reynold said that this is just a vacation for me. He also gave me vacation homework. He said that I can only come back for two months. After that, he will send someone to pick me up and bring me to his side to continue learning Mechanic knowledge."

Reynold had received Han Xiao's orders to teach Nero when Han Xiao wasn't around. Reynold carried out this responsibility seriously and had already arranged a year's worth of lessons for Nero.

"Black Star is willing to train you. This is a rare opportunity. Don't let him down." Bennett chuckled and squatted down so that he was at the same height as Nero. He looked at his child kindly and asked, "Tell me what you've seen in the universe."

Nero counted on his fingers and explained everything in detail with a happy tone. Although the homework that Han Xiao had given him made him depressed, this was his first time in space and he had seen all sorts of strange things. Thus, Nero was very satisfied with this trip.

As Bennett listened, he nodded with a smile and sighed in his heart.

He could sense that Han Xiao had high hopes for Nero, and it wasn't just because he was his child. Nero seemed to have some sort of talent that Han Xiao valued, and Bennett was very proud of this.

The child that he had created had such outstanding talent. It seemed like his genes were still very outstanding. Bennett was secretly considering if he should have a second child.

He wasn't willing to be too materialistic, but considering the future of Blue Star, if he had a few more children with outstanding talent and they all became Black Star's students, the bond between Blue Star and Black Star would be even stronger.

Although he was old, his body as a Pugilist was still full of energy.

In the Blue Star's list of the most popular and charming men, Bennett, as the leader of Blue Star, was ranked second. He was loved and supported by countless people. The popularity of the people was one of the reasons. On the other hand, his status, age, and strong body formed the charm of a stable and reliable old man.

As for the number one most popular and charming man in Blue Star … it was undoubtedly Han Xiao. No one could shake his position. With so many achievements as a foundation, no matter how the Blue Star people looked at him, they felt that he was very handsome.

Not long after, Nero's throat was parched from talking, and he took a deep breath. He wanted to excitedly share what he had seen and heard in the universe.

Bennett stopped him and rubbed his head. He stood up and said, "Alright, when you have time later, you can tell me more in detail. Go home and rest first. I still have to wait for someone here."

Nero was astonished. "Aren't you here to pick me up?"

Bennett shook his head and turned to look at the universe outside the window.

"I still have to receive an extremely important guest."

…

At the same time, far away from Blue Star, a secret blue cocoon-shaped spaceship was hovering in the universe. Through the over-the-horizon mode, it was observing the Blue Star from afar.

"This is Blue Star, Black Star's mother planet …"

In the cockpit of the spaceship, a creature with secret blue skin stared at the screen and said with a cold tone. He was the captain of this spaceship. He had four arms and three eyes, and all the crew members behind him had the same body structure as him.

This spaceship was full of Star Pupil God Race members.

The captain turned to look at the crew members and said coldly, "Black Star took away our national treasure. This is a humiliation to our entire race. Our leaders are weak, and our compatriots have to swallow their anger. What they can't and don't dare to do, we, the Avitan Souls, can and dare to do!"

The captain's tone was firm, and all the crew members were agitated. They gripped the weapons in their hands tightly with indignation.

"Because of the Evolution Cube, Planet Avitan was attacked, and countless compatriots were sacrificed. Our family and friends all died in that disaster. With so many people dead, we can't allow the Evolution Cube to fall into the hands of others! Maybe the culprit of that attack is not only EsGod but also Black Star! "

The captain pointed in the direction of Blue Star and roared, "Only by taking revenge with blood can we make Black Star regret his shameless actions. We will make him understand that the humiliation he gave the Star Pupil God Race and the despair he gave us will be repaid by someone!"

The crew members all had a common enemy and roared.

Back then, EsGod had almost massacred more than half of Planet Avitan in order to lure the tiger away from the mountain. That disaster was a painful memory for the Star Pupil Holy Race, and the anger of losing everything made some of the survivors lose their rationality and go to extremes. An extremist organization was born from that, called 'Avitan Souls of the Dead'. These extremists were basically the survivors of Avitan or had relatives or friends who had died in the disaster.

Because they had lost their national treasure, the Evolution Cube, Sisko's prestige in the Star Pupil God Race had declined. The extremists blamed the tragedy of Avitan on Sisko's incompetence and deeply hated the culprit, EsGod. Because the source of the disaster on Planet Avitan was the Evolution Cube, and so many of their compatriots had sacrificed themselves for it, the Avitan Souls had a morbid obsession with the Evolution Cube. Thus, they also hated Black Star, who had taken the Evolution Cube from the Star Pupil God Race.

The Evolution Cube was the national treasure in the eyes of the Star Pupil God Race, and this view had been maintained for many years. Now that the Evolution Cube had a new owner, the Star Pupil God Race had always been hostile toward Han Xiao. The Avitan Souls were even more extreme. Sisko was unable to take back the Evolution Cube and seemed to have stopped because he was afraid of the dynasty. This made the Avitan Souls lose confidence in Sisko and decide to use extreme methods to take revenge on Black Star.

Hearing that Han Xiao had left the Shattered Star Ring for a long time, the Avitan Souls felt that the time had come. They decided to use this opportunity to fearlessly attack Black Star's mother planet and carry out a terrifying revenge, making Black Star, who was far away on the horizon, watch as his mother planet was destroyed.

Blue Star was now a member of the Shattered Star Ring Civilization Conference, and even Sisko could not act recklessly. However, this kind of rule that the upper echelons had to abide by was not something that the extremists were willing to consider. They were unexpected factors that ignored the rules and did not care about the consequences at all. Everything they had was destroyed, and their rationality had been burned away by their anger.

Although Sisko was recognized as the best leader of the Star Pupil God Race, he could not control the thoughts of every member of his race. There would always be extreme cases in every group, and there would always be people who were blinded by hatred. Even the Star Pupil God Race, who had an extremely high average level of evolution, could not avoid internal disagreements.

The captain turned to look at his deputy. "How's the status of the weapons?"

The deputy nodded heavily. "Five Super Heavy Nuclear Psionic Annihilation Bombs are operating well and can be fired at any time."

"Very good. It's said that one of these bombs can destroy an entire continent, and more than three of them can destroy the surface of a planet. Our goal is to release all the bombs on Blue Star and let this planet die with us. We will let them feel the pain of Avitan." The captain's tone was vicious. The people on the ship did not plan to leave alive.

Although the power of these high-level psionic bombs could not be compared to Primordial Psionic Energy, they were still restricted weapons that the three Universal Civilizations prohibited from casually using. They would leave behind a terrifying psionic pollution effect, and only Star Cluster Civilizations would have them.

The Avitan Souls was an extremist organization that had not been established for long and did not have the corresponding technological strength. The bombs were actually secretly funded by someone, and the sponsor was the Star Cluster Civilization in the area where the Star Pupil God Race was located.

They had always viewed the rising Star Pupil God Race as a threat. Because of the background of the Arcane Church, they could not openly target the Star Pupil God Race. However, the birth of the Avitan Souls gave this Star Cluster Civilization an opportunity to obstruct their opponent. Thus, they used the name of a puppet organization to secretly support the Avitan Souls in an attempt to create trouble for the Star Pupil God Race.

Just as the captain was about to give the order to take action, a light dot suddenly appeared at the corner of the observation radar.

"Warning! An unknown large target is approaching! "

Everyone turned around and looked in the corresponding direction through the porthole. They saw a floating island in the universe flying over from afar, wrapped in a large yellow shield.

"Floating Dragon?" The captain recognized this floating island that everyone in the Shattered Star Ring knew about and wondered why it would appear there. From the looks of it, it was heading toward Blue Star.

The Floating Dragon Island slowly approached this secret blue cocoon-shaped spaceship. Compared to the size of the two, it was like an elephant compared to a sesame seed. Next to Floating Dragon, this spaceship produced by the Star Pupil God Race was as tiny as a speck of dust.

"Let's move aside. Don't block Floating Dragon's path."

The captain hurriedly ordered the pilot to move to the side. Floating Dragon was a neutral organization and would not actively attack any passing spaceships. He planned to stop the operation and wait for Floating Dragon to leave before attacking Blue Star.

Everyone was below Floating Dragon. Looking through the porthole, they could only see the rocks at the bottom of Floating Dragon.

The pilot raised the spaceship and flew above Floating Dragon's horizon, level with the city's horizon.

The captain and the others were stunned. They suddenly realized that Ames, who was wearing a black dress, was standing at the most eye-catching spot of Floating Dragon's dock. She was actually staring at their spaceship!

"She's looking at us?"

Just as this thought appeared in everyone's mind, an unparalleled force field suddenly descended.

Pu!

Blood splattered everywhere!

The bodies of all the Star Pupil God Race members on the spaceship were squashed at the same time, turning into red and blue meat paste. Their minds were frozen at the last thought, and they died without any warning.

At Floating Dragon's dock, Ames casually put down her hand and retracted the force field. She then ordered Vilna, who was waiting by the side, "Search this spaceship and see if there are any dangerous weapons hidden inside."

"Okay." Vilna immediately went to organize the manpower.

Then, Ames turned to look at Aesop, who was beside her, and raised her brows slightly.

"Are you sure the people on this spaceship are plotting against Blue Star? You didn't kill the wrong people, right? "

Aesop stroked his beard and chuckled. "You want to move Floating Dragon to Blue Star, so I made a prophecy about Blue Star a few days ago. These people are Sisko's people. They seem to want to destroy Blue Star to take revenge on Black Star because of the Evolution Cube. Although these people did not succeed in the end and were destroyed by the ground-to-air dark energy rail defense cannon that Black Star left here, since we're here, we might as well help."

Ames shook her head and said with some helplessness, "I didn't expect that we would really become his home guard."

Aesop glanced at her and said, "Didn't you move Floating Dragon to Blue Star to help Black Star protect his mother planet?"

"Heh, I'm maximizing the benefits of Floating Dragon and carrying out the agreement between allies. What does it have to do with him? Even if it's for others, it's for my two students. "Ames turned around and left. Her black dress was like a blooming flower, floating close to the ground.

Aesop watched Ames leave before turning to look at Jenny, whose hair was getting thinner day by day.

"We're almost at Blue Star. Inform them."

Jenny nodded expressionlessly.

…

Bennett had been standing at the dock, looking up at the universe.

A shadow suddenly appeared under their feet and quickly expanded, covering the entire dock.

A gigantic floating island appeared in his line of sight. It slowly approached Planet Aquamarine and enlarged in Bennett's line of sight.

Bennett smiled.

"The guests are finally here."
